title: Hatsune Miku — So Hoppy To See You!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Humhumhummm♪
What should I do today☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe practice a new dance with the plushies? Oh, oh, or I could sing songs with the flowers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmm... Huh? Who's that over there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heeey, Tsukasa!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, hello there, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the moment, I'm waiting to meet up with Emu and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're planning to practice our final assignment for the workshop.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Final assignment?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To sum it up, it's something of an overall review of everything we covered in the workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The assignment is to perform a song from the musical “Finding the Rainbow”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But both the song itself and the choreography are very advanced! And the characters' emotions in the scene are complex, which requires us to take care with our acting too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, so it's super hard!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... We've tried it many times now, but we're still struggling.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However! Today is the day we succeed! I've watched the cast recording so many times I've burned it into my screen, all to capture it perfectly in my mind!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're all super powered up and motivated, huh♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, I wanna see the video too! I'm curious what the song's like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha, of course! Here, this is it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! The dance moves are all super sharp and swishy! So cool! And there are so many feelings swirling around in the song too! How wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It is known as a masterpiece among musical numbers, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh, wow! Still, the singing and the dancing and the acting really do look hard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They are. We're struggling with the choreography right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The steps are so precise that even though we understand how it goes, our bodies just can't keep up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, it started out like this, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tappy tappy step step♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oho, well done, Miku. You've learned it already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this is where it gets difficult, and suddenly. The tempo changes rapidly, and—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tappy tappy tappy♪ Tappy step step tap♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, wait, wait! How did you do that?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was the part I've been struggling with, and you made it look so easy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnng...! As a future star, I cannot allow myself to be outshone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You just watch! I'll catch up in no time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gwah!!! I tripped at the same place as always!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, but you were so close that time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You stick your right foot out like whoop, and then with your left foot, you go bip-bip-bop.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And then, you move your arms like fwoosh fwoosh fwoosh fwoosh flappy flappy. Give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know what you're saying!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoop! And then, bip-bip-bop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not polished enough yet, but how was that for a start?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that was great! You got the timing down just right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll dance with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Please do!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here we go!
Tappy tappy tappy♪ Tappy step step tap♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff, huff...
How was that, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did it!
You really nailed it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Haha, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yesss! I have mastered those steps!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hooray! Congrats, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It really does fire me up to have someone so capable to practice with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With your help, I've conquered one of the pain points in the choreography.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? One of them? So that's not the only hard part?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That is what's so vexing about this song.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The section after this one is even more difficult and even more confusing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Then I wanna try that one too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought you might say that. Let's see which of us can conquer it first!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe. I won't lose☆
se_walk_women_002_2
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? They've started practicing already...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heeey! Tsukasa, Miku! Let us join in too!
